notes.title: Balance and bug-fix patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed rank change animation displaying negative instead of positive

Fixed Hull Support Beam description missing percentage sign

Fixed ions not removing electricity from enemy ships

Fixed Buzz Saw applying rust effect too many times
Balance Changes
Shipping Pallet now grants hull instead of only max hull

Flight Deck radar gain: 2 → 1

Synthesizer hull cost: 4 → 3

Spike Factory armor gain: 5 → 6

Spikes percentage damage: 3% → 5%

Blaster Cannon cost: 3 → 4

Slug Cannon cost: 3 → 4

Buzz Saw rust chance: 20% → 25%

Combat Medic hull restore: 6% → 8%

Titan Core hull gain: 4% → 5%

Ion Rifle charge speed: 7% → 8%

Galvanized Plate armor gain: 5 → 8

Reactive Plating chance: 40% → 50%
